sources.observed_operation: Read Microsoft Learn CPU rate result and basic-limit result; no setting applied.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Configured CPU rate is a cap; after a job reaches the cap for an interval, its threads cannot run until the next interval. Job-wide committed-memory limit requires JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_JOB_MEMORY and an extended limit structure; it is not an assumed default.
sources.applicability: Windows resource-control option. Platform/version/RDS scheduler conditions and explicit setup matter; caps do not promise user-perceived responsiveness.

sources.governing_condition_default_exception: JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_JOB_MEMORY caps the sum of committed memory in the job and requires an extended limit structure; JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_PROCESS_MEMORY caps each process; JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_JOB_TIME is a user-mode time limit. These are enabled by flags rather than automatic defaults.
sources.applicability: Windows enforcement mechanism for native process jobs. It is not equivalent to a wall-clock deadline and must be configured with child containment and OS-specific behavior.
